title: Locked cards on desktop
caption: At Lv 1 in Advanced, Skills, Daevanion and Stigmas are faded shells that say when they open: Lv 4, after Urgent Pursuit, Lv 22.

title: Locked cards hidden in Basic
caption: At Lv 1 in Basic the three locked cards are left out, so Next up moves to the top.

title: Locked cards hidden on phones
caption: On a phone at Lv 1 the locked cards are left out too; nothing pushes the page down.

title: Skills opens at Lv 4
caption: At Lv 4 the Skills card fills in where its shell stood; Daevanion and Stigmas stay faded until they open.
